syndromes.title: Invasive lomentosporiosis
rows: Voriconazole IV 6 mg/kg BID day 1 → 4 mg/kg BID from day 2 + terbinafine 500–1000 mg/day; use TDM

No evidence supports a fixed pre-specified duration. ≥4–6 months of combination therapy has been most associated with positive outcomes and is moderately recommended; individualize to immune recovery and disease resolution.
Hoenigl 2021 Rare Mould Suppl | Fig 9 | PDF p49
